title: The Missing Minute
narration: My dashcam deletes the same minute from every journey. A hidden second camera showed me collecting an escaped woman in a hospital gown and driving her to a warehouse. An officer deleted the evidence and claimed I transported dangerous patients for a secret programme. Then the camera revealed an identical hospital wristband beneath his sleeve. The dashboard returned to 11:46 as he raised a syringe. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. When I woke, the woman was gone and exactly one minute had vanished again.
